- **Run on the final head:** the story's acceptance suite ran on b58f11f with a clean tree: 7 pass, 0 fail, 1 manual (TC-10-19).
- **Live model:** I also ran TC-10-19 by hand against gemma4:e4b: date right 98 %, every field right 93 %, and both B1 sentences now read correctly.
